entities.name: Timer T3480
entities.description: Timer used in the UE requested bearer resource allocation procedure. Controls retransmission of BEARER RESOURCE ALLOCATION REQUEST messages.

entities.name: UE requested bearer resource allocation procedure
entities.description: Procedure initiated by the UE to request allocation of bearer resources.

entities.name: BEARER RESOURCE ALLOCATION REQUEST
entities.description: Message sent by the UE to request bearer resource allocation.

entities.name: BEARER RESOURCE ALLOCATION REJECT
entities.description: Message sent to reject a bearer resource allocation request.

entities.name: DEACTIVATE EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST
entities.description: Message used to initiate EPS bearer context deactivation.

entities.name: PROCEDURE TRANSACTION INACTIVE
entities.description: State entered when a procedure transaction is completed or aborted.

entities.name: Fifth expiry of timer T3480
entities.description: Condition when timer T3480 expires for the fifth time during the bearer resource allocation procedure.

entities.name: Unknown EPS bearer context
entities.description: Condition when BEARER RESOURCE ALLOCATION REJECT includes ESM cause #43 indicating invalid EPS bearer identity.

entities.name: Collision of bearer resource allocation and deactivation procedures
entities.description: Condition when UE receives DEACTIVATE EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST for the default bearer context during bearer resource allocation procedure.

entities.name: Abort procedure
entities.description: Action to terminate the ongoing procedure and release associated resources.

entities.name: Deactivate default EPS bearer context locally
entities.description: Action to deactivate the default EPS bearer context without peer-to-peer signaling.

relations.description: The UE requested bearer resource allocation procedure starts timer T3480.
The UE requested bearer resource allocation procedure includes sending BEARER RESOURCE ALLOCATION REQUEST messages.
Fifth expiry of timer T3480 causes the UE to abort the bearer resource allocation procedure.
Fifth expiry of timer T3480 causes the UE to enter PROCEDURE TRANSACTION INACTIVE state.
Receipt of BEARER RESOURCE ALLOCATION REJECT with ESM cause #43 causes UE to deactivate default EPS bearer context locally.
Receipt of BEARER RESOURCE ALLOCATION REJECT with ESM cause #43 causes UE to stop timer T3480.
Collision with deactivation procedure causes UE to abort the bearer resource allocation procedure.
Collision with deactivation procedure causes UE to stop timer T3480.
BEARER RESOURCE ALLOCATION REJECT message with ESM cause #43 triggers the unknown EPS bearer context condition.
DEACTIVATE EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST message triggers the procedure collision condition.
